description: This source file contains a React functional component 'PublicModelHub' that renders a comprehensive dashboard for browsing, filtering, and viewing details of models, agents, and MCP servers in a machine learning deployment platform. It manages state, fetches data from network calls, defines table columns, and provides modals for detailed views and interactions.

methods.name: publicModelHubColumns
methods.description: Defines the column configuration for the models data table, including rendering functions, sorting, and formatting for each column such as name, providers, mode, features, limits, and costs.

methods.name: publicAgentHubColumns
methods.description: Defines the column configuration for the agents data table, including rendering functions for name, description, version, provider, skills, capabilities, input/output modes, and documentation links.

methods.name: publicMCPHubColumns
methods.description: Defines the column configuration for the MCP servers data table, including server name, description, URL, transport, and auth type, with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
